decisions.statement: treat retained grid points adjacent by one structured-grid index step along exactly one axis as one six-neighbor connected speed region

compute speed as the euclidean magnitude of the stored point-data vector array named `vectors`, then define high-speed locations as those at or above the 90th percentile of its non-zero values using linear quantile interpolation
use peak speed as the measure of strength
represent the strongest region by the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations

findings.statement: The selected strongest region has a mean spatial location approximately [137.80844557699308, 94.49144521295959, 15.773061521659992] in the dataset coordinate frame.
The selected strongest region has peak speed strength approximately 22.694928 in the stored velocity scale.
